item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Unification of Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kook realistically impossible... Would consider if Yoo Ui-dong and Hwang Kyo-ahn unify" (정청래 “김용남·조국 단일화, 현실적으로 불가...유의동·황교안 단일화 땐 숙고)
item.description:
With early voting for the June 3rd local elections (May 29-30) just one day away, Democratic Party Representative Jung Cheong-rae stated that the unification of pro-government candidates in the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly by-election is "realistically difficult." (6·3지방선거 사전투표(29~30일)가 하루 앞으로 다가온 가운데, 더불어민주당 정청래 대표는 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거의 범여권 후보 단일화와 관련, “현실적으로 어렵다”고 했다.)

Representative Jung appeared on Kim Eo-joon's YouTube broadcast this morning and said this regarding the possibility of unification between Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kook Innovation Party candidate Cho Kook. (정 대표는 이날 오전 김어준씨 유튜브 방송에 출연해 민주당 김용남 후보와 조국혁신당 조국 후보 간 단일화 가능성에 대해 이같이 말했다.)

Representative Jung disclosed the meeting between Democratic Party Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae and Cho Kook Innovation Party Secretary-General Lee Hae-min the previous day, adding, "(From what I was told, they met, but it was at a level where there was no discussion of unification at all." This is interpreted as meaning they effectively failed to find common ground for unification. (정 대표는 전날 민주당 조승래 사무총장과 조국혁신당 이해민 사무총장의 회동 사실을 공개하며 “(보고를 받아 보니) 만나긴 했지만 단일화 논의 자체가 없었다고 볼 수준이었다”고 했다. 사실상 단일화 접점을 찾지 못했다는 취지로 풀이된다.)

Representative Jung also gave his stance on the differing opinions within the party regarding allegations that Candidate Kim operated a loan company under a borrowed name. He said, "It's true that some party members actively support him because he is a Democratic Party candidate, while others do not," and added, "(Even as the party leader, I cannot decide whether a candidate should withdraw,) so I hope Candidate Kim will actively explain himself and handle it well." (정 대표는 김 후보의 대부업체 차명 운영 의혹과 관련, 당내 의견이 엇갈리는 상황에 대해서도 입장을 내놨다. 그는 “김 후보가 민주당 후보이기 때문에 열심히 지지하자는 당원도, 그렇지 못한 당원도 있는 것이 사실”이라며 “(당 대표라 할지라도 후보 사퇴 여부를 결정할 수 있는 것은 아니기 때문에) 김 후보 스스로 적극 해명하고 잘 헤쳐나갔으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the possibility of a unification between People Power Party Candidate Yoo Ui-dong, who is running in Pyeongtaek-eul, and Freedom and Innovation Candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn, Representative Jung said, "We must prepare for all possibilities," adding, "If that situation arises, we will reconsider." This is interpreted as indicating that the party leadership will actively take steps to unify Kim and Cho if conservative candidates unify. (정 대표는 평택을에 출마한 국민의힘 유의동 후보와 자유와혁신 황교안 후보가 단일화하는 경우에 대해선 “모든 가능성에 대비해야 한다”면서 “그런 상황이 되면 다시 숙고할 것”이라고 했다. 보수 진영 후보의 단일화 시 김, 조 후보가 단일화하도록 당 지도부 차원에서 적극 나설 가능성을 밝힌 것으로 풀이된다.)

Currently, the Democratic Party and the Cho Kook Innovation Party are engaged in a war of nerves over the unification of Candidates Kim and Cho. On the 27th, the Cho Kook Innovation Party once again criticized the allegations that Candidate Kim owned a loan company under a borrowed name, urging the Democratic Party to "make a swift decision." This is in favor of unifying behind Candidate Cho. In response, Candidate Kim's camp retorted, "Look at what charges (Candidate Cho) was sentenced to prison for and served time for." (현재 민주당과 조국혁신당은 김, 조 후보 단일화를 두고 신경전을 벌이고 있다. 조국혁신당은 지난 27일에도 김 후보의 대부업체 차명 보유 의혹을 재차 비판하며 민주당에 “신속한 결단”을 촉구했다. 조 후보로 단일화하자는 취지다. 이에 대해 김 후보 측은 “(조 후보) 본인이 어떤 죄명으로 실형을 선고받고 복역했는지 살펴보라”고 반발했다.)

On the other hand, it is known that People Power Party Candidate Yoo Ui-dong and Freedom and Innovation Candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn recently met in person but failed to narrow their differences over the method of unification. However, Candidate Yoo said on KBS Radio, "There's no reason we can't unify," and Candidate Hwang also stated in a phone call with this newspaper, "We are discussing through various channels," leaving open the possibility of a last-minute agreement. (반면 국민의힘 유의동, 자유와혁신 황교안 후보는 최근 직접 만났지만 단일화 방식에 이견을 좁히지 못한 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 유 후보는 KBS 라디오에서 “단일화 못할 이유가 없다”고 했고, 황 후보도 본지 통화에서 “여러 경로를 통해서 논의하고 있다”고 해 막판 타결 가능성은 남아 있다.)

item.title: DPK's Park Ji-won: “A 13-to-3 Result Would Be a Ruling Party Victory” (민주당 박지원 “13대3 정도면 여당 승리”)
item.description:
Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Park Ji-won stated on the 28th that if the Democratic Party wins in 13 of the 16 metropolitan and provincial governor races in the June 3 local elections, it can be considered a victory for the ruling party. Regarding former President Park Geun-hye’s campaign appearance in Busan to support the People Power Party, the lawmaker suggested this could ultimately benefit Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, who is running in the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election. (박지원 더불어민주당 의원은 6·3지방선거 광역단체장 선거 16곳 중 민주당이 13곳에서 승리하면 여당의 승리로 볼 수 있다고 28일 밝혔다. 박 의원은 박근혜 전 대통령이 부산에서 국민의힘 지원 유세에 나선 것을 두고 결국은 부산 북갑 재보궐에 출마한 민주당 하정우 후보에게 유리하게 돌아올 수 있다고 했다.)

In an interview with MBC Radio that day, when asked, “Can a result of 13 to 3 be seen as a Democratic Party victory?” Park replied, “That would still be a victory.” He added, “At first, I thought only Gyeongsangbuk-do would be difficult, and I even said it would be a ‘15-to-1’ (15-to-1 victory for the Democratic Party). In the early stages, each party talks big to rally their own party and support base.” He continued, “Anyway, just like in golf, in elections you shouldn’t lift your head; I’ll adhere to that and keep working until the end.” <<> When asked whether a result worse than 13 to 3 could hinder party leader Jung Cheong-rae’s bid for a second term, Park merely responded, “The outcome of this local election will be important, but many factors will determine that.” <<> On former President Park Geun-hye’s campaign appearance in Busan, Park Ji-won remarked, “Perhaps if Representative Chang Dong-hyuk fails in this local election, former President Park Geun-hye might become party leader. She has appeal among certain factions.” <<> In the three-way race in Busan Buk-gu Gap—involving independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik, and Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo—Park Ji-won viewed former President Park’s appearance as potentially advantageous for Ha Jung-woo. He explained, “In Busan Buk-gu Gap, because the former president is supporting Park Min-sik, votes for Han Dong-hoon might bleed away (to Park Min-sik), making Ha Jung-woo’s election more certain.” (박 의원은 이날 MBC라디오 인터뷰에서 ‘13대 3 정도면 민주당의 승리로 볼 수 있느냐’는 질문에 “그래도 승리”라고 했다. 박 의원은 “처음에는 경북만 어렵고, ‘15 대 1(15대 1로 민주당이 승리)’ 이런 얘기를 저도 했다”라며 “초입 단계에선 자기 당과 지지 세력을 응집시키기 위해서 정당마다 큰소리를 친다”고 했다. 이어 “아무튼 골프나 선거는 고개 쳐들면 안 된다 하는 것을 준수하고 끝까지 노력할 것”이라고 했다.)
